answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making reputation cost something that cannot be cloned: staked, time-locked collateral bonded to each identity, slashed when an agent is caught colluding. Think of the market as a river and each bond as a jetty: a fake identity needs its own jetty, and every one must be built with real capital that stays locked for weeks. Honest agents wander freely between services, but an attacker with a thousand personas must lock a thousand deposits.
